game.core.rules.readable.title: Ability Checks and Skills
game.core.rules.readable.summary: An ability check tests an attempted action against a Difficulty Class, using the selected ability and any recorded skill proficiency that applies.

blocks.heading: Resolve a check
items: Choose the ability that matches the attempted action and set the Difficulty Class.
Apply the character's recorded ability modifier and applicable proficiency or Expertise.
Resolve the d20 test and compare its total with the Difficulty Class.

blocks.heading: Skills describe training
blocks.body: A skill can supply proficiency for a relevant ability check; it does not replace the ability chosen for the attempt.

examples.title: A trained search
examples.body: When Investigation is relevant, the recorded skill rank determines whether proficiency is included in the Intelligence check.
